name: Landhaus Wildschütz
beschreibung: Landhaus Wildschütz is peacefully located in a sunny panoramic setting in the idyllic Tyrolean mountain enclave of Jungholz within the Reutte district, surrounded by the Allgäu Alps. This family-run guesthouse pairs genuine warmth with relaxing alpine comfort. Comfortable guest rooms and holiday apartments feature private balconies overlooking the Sorgschrofen peak. A pleasant garden lawn invites leisurely outdoor relaxation. Winter guests enjoy immediate proximity to the family-friendly Jungholz ski area with modern chairlifts and ski schools, while summer offers scenic hiking paths directly from the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine holiday house in the Tyrolean village of Jungholz featuring mountain views and ski proximity.
